integrity: Every matrix, cycle, orientation convention, exact determinant, and finite automorphism enumeration is reconstructed by the supplied standalone verifier. The proof depends on the classical Abrams discretization theorem. The mathematical review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The complete relation presentation applies to the Heawood graph and unordered two-point configuration space only; no general graph-family theorem is asserted. The abstract second-homology group and the existence of an integral fourteen-torus basis were known, and are not novelty claims. Comparison with indexed literature cannot eliminate possible equivalent work in unindexed sources.
title: Complete integral relations among paired-hexagon tori in the Heawood two-point configuration space
